floater.name: floater_as_inventory_rules
floater.title: Inventory Rules
floater.string: No rulesets yet. Click New Ruleset to create one.
floater.text: A ruleset is a list of rules that find items or folders and move or delete them.

button.label: Execute All
button.name: execute_all_btn
button.tool_tip: Run every ruleset in list order

button.label: Dry Run
button.name: dry_run_btn
button.tool_tip: List what every ruleset would do, without changing anything

button.label: Stop
button.name: stop_btn
button.tool_tip: Stop after the batch in progress is confirmed

flyout_button.label: Export
flyout_button.name: export_btn
flyout_button.tool_tip: Copy every ruleset with its rules to the clipboard as JSON (a backup). The arrow also offers a file.

flyout_button.label: Import
flyout_button.name: import_btn
flyout_button.tool_tip: Add rulesets from JSON in the clipboard (one ruleset or a full export), at the end of the list. Nothing is replaced or executed. The arrow also offers a file.

button.label: Revert...
button.name: revert_btn
button.tool_tip: Undo a past run, by the run ID that ends its log notecard name in /logs
